title: openai.service_tier
description: The service tier that actually processed the request, echoed on openai/chat_completions (and /responses) response envelopes: one of auto, default, flex, scale, priority — kept open here because the tier vocabulary is provider-operational and grows without notice. Provider-unique latency/throughput routing metadata with no canonical home; rides ChatResponse.extensions with an EXTENSIONS FieldLoss so it is preserved and reported, never portable-by-pretense.
x-ocai-promotion: promote if a second provider ships a congruent response-side tier echo
